title: 第19章 最得寸进尺的嫌疑人第20章 李宏财女儿回来了
content_zh:
;;
张涛眉头一皱：“证据呢？”
李向东拿出手机，把昨晚拍到的内容放到他面前。
“这就是。”
张涛看完视频，脸色微微现出波动，不动声色的把手机推了回来。
“内容我看了，不过不能说明什么。”
“根据这个姚安平的控诉，李二狗偷鱼的事情是你们村的内部矛盾。”
“他只负责收鱼，这事与他无关，他也不知情。”
“他现在控告的是另外一件事。”
“昨晚在他们到达之前，你就提前半个月，指使陈阿四三人陆陆续续把池塘里的鱼卖给了他。”
“总计从他那儿获取鱼款两万三千多元。”
“然后又以买鱼的事诓骗他过来，联合村长李宏财从他身上又敲诈到两万才放他离开。”
“是不是有这个事？”
李向东听完他的陈述，哈哈一笑。
“他说我联合李宏财敲诈他，那为什么现在只把我一个人带过来。”
“李宏财人呢？”
“偷鱼的李二狗人呢？”
张涛看一眼外面刚办理的交接，感觉这事有些蹊跷，眉头一皱说道：
“我们查了你的账户，这个钱进了你的口袋里就一直没出来。”
“所以......”

“所以就冤枉我，偷鱼被抓给我钱了结事情，事后又让我一个人来背这锅？”
李向东抢先一步做了回答。
张涛被怼得无言以对。
能把一个条理简单的案子办成这样，这中间如果没有人特殊关照很难说得过去。
看来他这趟基层下得不冤，桃源镇里确实存在些问题。
张涛被问倒，什么话也没说，收拾东西走了出去。
很快他就又拿了一份调解书过来，严肃道：
“我看过你的档案资料，在大学毕业之前都很优秀。”
“如果不是那个污点，你我恐怕不会在这样的地方相见。”
李向东被提起往事，依旧保持着不动声色。
张涛见这样都打不开话匣子，心中暗暗称赞这年轻人城府真深。
继续抛诱饵：
“我刚去找姚安平谈了，你们之间的这个事，最终定性就取决于他的控诉。”
“往大了说，一个敲诈，一个收受赃物，都要严肃处理。”
“但如果你愿意接受调解，退还李宏财承诺过的那一万元。”
“我倒是可以帮你们一个忙。”
如果是一般人得到这样的允诺，肯定会立马调解。
content_en:
;;
Zhang Tao frowned: "Where is the evidence?"
Li Xiangdong took out his mobile phone and put the content taken last night in front of him.
"This is it."
After watching the video, Zhang Tao's expression fluctuated slightly and he pushed the phone back calmly.
"I've read the content, but I can't explain anything."
"According to Yao Anping's complaint, Li Ergou's stealing of fish is an internal conflict in your village."
"He is only responsible for collecting fish. This matter has nothing to do with him and he has no knowledge."
"He's now charging something else."
"Before they arrived last night, you instructed Chen Asi and three others to sell him the fish in the pond one after another half a month in advance."
"The total amount of fish money obtained from him was more than 23,000 yuan."
"Then he tricked him into coming here with the promise of buying fish, and together with village chief Li Hongcai, he extorted another 20,000 yuan from him before letting him leave."
"Is this the case?"
Li Xiangdong laughed after hearing his statement.
"He said that I teamed up with Li Hongcai to blackmail him, so why did he only bring me here now?"
"Where is Mr. Li Hongcai?"
"Where's Li Ergou who stole the fish?"
Zhang Tao took a look at the handover that had just been completed outside and felt that this matter was a bit strange. He frowned and said:
"We checked your account, and the money went into your pocket and never came out."
"So..."
"So you unjustly accused me, and when I was caught stealing fish, you gave me money to settle the matter, and then you made me take the blame alone?"
Li Xiangdong answered first.
Zhang Tao was speechless.
It would be hard to justify a simple case being handled like this without special care from someone.
It seems that his trip to the grassroots level was not unjust. There are indeed some problems in Taoyuan Town.
Zhang Tao was knocked down by the question, but without saying anything, he packed up his things and walked out.
Soon he brought over another mediation document and said seriously:
"I've seen your profile, and you were excellent until you graduated from college."
"If it weren't for that stain, I'm afraid you and I wouldn't have met in a place like this."
Li Xiangdong remained calm when the past was mentioned.
Seeing that Zhang Tao couldn't open up the conversation like this, he secretly praised this young man for his richness.
Keep throwing bait:
"I just went to talk to Yao Anping. The final determination of this matter between you depends on his accusation."
"Taking it seriously, any case of extortion or receiving stolen goods must be dealt with seriously."
"But if you are willing to accept mediation, return the 10,000 yuan promised by Li Hongcai."
"I can do you a favor."
If an ordinary person received such a promise, they would definitely mediate immediately.
